upstream.relationship: SDD methodology provider: methodology and tooling this repo conforms to
native-driver-provider: PHP Firebird extension this DBAL driver bridges; ext-firebird constraint and version pins track its release line

framework-provider: DBAL SPI this driver implements (Driver, AbstractPlatform, SchemaManager, Comparator); supported range per composer.json require constraint; upstream retired its 4.4.x branch - 4.5.x/4.6.x/5.0.x are the live sync surfaces, 5.0 is the next contract-break review point
integration-test-provider: ORM-level Integration-ReadOnly suite target (require-dev; consumed transitively at runtime via dbal); supported range per composer.json require-dev constraint

downstream.relationship: entity layer and platform consumers of this DBAL driver (names redacted - IPADP privacy rule forbids public-to-private interlinking). Coordination is handover comments on this repo's issues only; consumer-lane verifications run in the consumers' own CI. Public docs alias these consumers as `private-erp-consumer` / `private-erp` (sweep 2026-10-27, #251).
